items.title: NeuroSeed @ 2026 香港腦力多元研討會
items.excerpt: NeuroSeed 將參與2026 香港腦力多元研討會，向大家介紹我們的原創教育培訓項目《腦細話事》Brainy In-Charge。
body: NeuroSeed 將參與2026 香港腦力多元研討會，向大家介紹我們的原創教育培訓項目《腦細話事》Brainy In-Charge。
歡迎大家親臨支持，認識我們如何透過遊戲化學習，支持老師陪伴學童探索情緒、心理健康與成長挑戰。現場設有簡單互動活動，包括分享你關注的學童成長議題、寫下支持說話，以及共同建構「大腦連結」藝術作品。參與者亦可獲得項目宣傳品及「腦細心語卡」，一起為學童送上鼓勵與支持！
歡迎到訪 Brown Rice x NeuroSeed 展區，與我們的宣傳大使親身交流！

items.title: NeuroSeed @ Hong Kong Neurodiversity Conference 2026
items.excerpt: NeuroSeed will be joining the Hong Kong Neurodiversity Conference 2026 to introduce our original educational training programme, 《腦細話事》Brainy In-Charge.
body: NeuroSeed will be joining the Hong Kong Neurodiversity Conference 2026 to introduce our original educational training programme, 《腦細話事》Brainy In-Charge.

We warmly invite you to come and support us, and learn more about how we use game-based learning to help teachers support students in exploring emotions, mental well-being, and growth challenges. Our booth will feature simple interactive activities, including sharing the student development issues you care about, writing a message of support, and co-creating a “brain connection” artwork. Participants can also receive project promotional materials and Brainy Message Cards, joining us in sending encouragement and support to students!
Come visit the Brown Rice x NeuroSeed booth and connect with our ambassadors in person!
